title: STRIVE: Multi-Agent Structured Temporal Reasoning with Integrated Verification for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Longitudinal radiology report generation (LRRG) requires identifying both current findings and their changes relative to a prior study. Existing methods jointly model diagnosis, attribute estimation, temporal comparison, and language generation within implicit representations, which can cause task interference, obscure the evidence underlying each decision, and limit error traceability. They also model progression states as independent labels, ignoring their ordered structure and thus treating missed changes and direction reversals equally. We present STRIVE, Multi-Agent Structured Temporal Reasoning with Integrated Verification for LRRG, which decomposes clinical reasoning into specialized Diagnosis, Attribute, and Temporal Change Agents that produce explicit intermediate evidence. translated_title: STRIVE：面向纵向放射学报告生成的多智能体结构化时间推理与集成验证
translated_abstract: 纵向放射学报告生成（LRRG）需要识别当前发现及其相对于先前研究的变化。现有方法在隐式表示中联合建模诊断、属性估计、时间比较和语言生成，这可能导致任务干扰、模糊每个决策背后的证据，并限制错误可追溯性。它们还将进展状态建模为独立标签，忽略其有序结构，从而将遗漏变化和方向反转同等对待。我们提出了STRIVE，一种用于LRRG的多智能体结构化时间推理与集成验证方法，它将临床推理分解为专门的诊断、属性和时间变化智能体，这些智能体产生明确的中间证据。特别是，时间变化智能体进一步使用进展感知GRPO进行后训练，这是一种可验证的、形状化的奖励，为方向分配部分信用。
tldr: 本文提出STRIVE，通过多智能体分解临床推理并利用进展感知GRPO奖励，解决纵向放射学报告生成中的任务干扰和有序进展建模问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents STRIVE, which decomposes clinical reasoning into specialized agents and uses progression-aware GRPO rewards to address task interference and ordered progression modeling in longitudinal radiology report generation.
